content_record.title: Mitochondria as Brain Aging Hubs: Beyond Neurons
content_record.editorial_body: A new review maps how mitochondrial dysfunction spreads across brain cell types, revealing intercellular transfer as a metabolic lifeline and targeting mitochondria as a therapeutic frontier. Mitochondria integrate and amplify brain aging across neurons, glia, and vascular cells. Intercellular mitochondrial transfer offers a novel metabolic rescue mechanism. Clinical trials now test mitochondria-targeted interventions for cognitive decline. This signal is based on Mitochondria and brain aging: From cell-specific dysfunction to intercellular cooperation. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
